messages:
Deploy Bot: Canary roll initiated for inference-gateway v2 -> v2.1 (roll_id=roll-2026-03-14-14:20). 10% traffic to canary. Auto-monitoring enabled.
Oncall Bot: Pager: ERROR_RATE_HIGH on inference-gateway.canary (threshold 2.5% -> 7.8%).
Sam (oncall): Got the pager, looking. seeing 5xx spike for canary shard in logs. tagging Maya. @Maya can you grab logs?
Maya (sre): On it. pulling canary logs now. quick glance: upstream timeouts + model-serving 503s, stack trace shows KV cache misses piling up.
Sam (oncall): Is this a rollout config mismatch or infra capacity?
Ali (infra): Early signal looks infra-y: GPU pod oom kill count rose on canary nodes 2->5 in 10m. But autoscale didn't spin up. investigating scaling policy.
Tess (prodeng): Important: rolling back will affect feature flag gating we enabled. If we kill the feature flag we can route 10% back to stable immediately.
Jordan (CS): Any customer-visible errors yet? I'm seeing a handful of support tickets for timeouts from a single enterprise tenant on the canary region. ETA 1st impact escalations.
Sam (oncall): Can we flip the kill-switch? show me the flag endpoint.
Tess (prodeng): use: `curl -X POST https://flags.redwood.internal/roll-2026-03-14/kill` (auth token required). I can run if infra approves.
Ali (infra): Hold — we need to confirm metric tagging first. Our canary traffic tags are missing in the main latency dashboard (looks like a tag key rename in the deploy). If we kill now, SLO calc might misattribute.
Maya (sre): That's the observability gap: graphs for canary use tag `env:canary`, but deployment emitted `canary: true` so dashboards didn't pick it up. hence the alert fired as global metric, noisy.
Sam (oncall): So alerts were noisy because tag mismatch? that explains why notifications went to infra channel. Can we suppress global alerts while we fix tag mapping?
Maya (sre): I'll mute the ERROR_RATE_HIGH alert for 15m on the global rule and create a temporary canary-specific alert matching the `canary: true` label.
Maya (sre): (muted rule id: alert-4433) 
Maya (sre): creating new rule: `metric.error_rate{canary="true"} > 3% for 2m`
Maya (sre): Done. New canary alert wired to eng-sre.
Sam (oncall): Good. Meanwhile, Tess, please execute the flag kill. Jordan, please notify affected customer that we're rolling traffic back and investigating.
Tess (prodeng): Executing kill now:
```
curl -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://flags.redwood.internal/roll-2026-03-14/kill
```
Tess (prodeng): Response: 200 OK, flag state -> killed. Routing back to stable.
Ops Bot: Traffic reroute completed: canary -> stable 10% -> 0%. No rolling restarts.
Sam (oncall): Confirming error rate on global now dropping. initial SLO burn looked like 0.4% across global but canary accounted for most.
Maya (sre): Note: SLO reporting is double-counting some requests for canary because of duplicate tagging in tracing layer. we'll need a postmortem on SLO calc + tag schema enforcement.
Ali (infra): Autoscale failure root cause: new HPA config used annotation `autoscale.v2` but cluster only reads `autoscale.v1` in that k8s distro. rollout pipeline didn't validate HPA version. Fixing pipeline check now.
Sam (oncall): Customer impact: Jordan: any update on tickets?
Jordan (CS): Updated affected customer: brief outage for some API calls in region-us-west-2 for ~12 min during canary window. They saw 3-5% error rate. We're offering timeline and asking if they need any logs.
Sam (oncall): Action items for immediate follow-up:
- Maya: create postmortem draft (obs gap: tag rename -> missing dashboards; SLO calc duplication).
- Ali: ensure rollout validations include HPA schema validation + test in staging.
- Tess: add a canary predeploy check that validates tags emitted by service and verifies dashboards pick them up.
- Jordan/CS: log customer impact and teaser note for legal/comms if they escalate.
Maya (sre): Will open incident PM with severity P2 and assign. tagging eng-oncall, infra, prodeng.
Sam (oncall): Handoff to next oncall in 30m — I'm starting the postmortem skeleton now, will ping next oncall when done.
Oncall Bot: Reminder: handoff in 30m to Maya.
Maya (sre): A couple follow-ups while it's fresh: we should add an automated sanity check in the deploy pipeline that queries dashboard endpoints with the expected tag set and fails the deploy if metrics missing for 3 consecutive polling intervals.
Ali (infra): Agreed. Also propose adding a regression test for HPA annotation compatibility across supported k8s versions.
Tess (prodeng): I'll add the canary-tag validation to the release checklist and make the flag kill flow documented in runbook.
Sam (oncall): Thanks everyone. logging this thread as reference for postmortem. Closing local paging now. :white_check_mark:
